newsitem.title: USA: Tosco not affected by NJ electric substation fire.
newsitem.headline: Tosco not affected by NJ electric substation fire.

text.p: The fire at the "Bayway" electrical substation in Elizabeth, N.J., apparently has had no effect on Tosco Corp's refinery bearing the same name, one of Tosco's top executives told Reuters Friday.
Tosco President Jay Allen said he had not been contacted about any disruptions to operations at the refinery, which can process up to 240,000 barrels per day of crude oil.
"I'd be surprised if there was a problem from (the substation fire)," Allen said.
Public Service Electric & Gas said the fire at the substation knocked out power to about 35,000 customers, including parts of New International Airport.
